stations.title: Hesper
stations.note: The supplier is on the phone.

stations.title: Your reader
stations.text: Says the index of the stray character.

captions: At Ashgrove Press, Hesper rings the card supplier about their broken list.
The reader says only an index, and nobody can find character 194 in a file.
You make every error say where, what was expected and what was found, in three tasks.
Now the error gives a line and a column, and says a value was expected there.
Same broken list, and the supplier knows exactly what to fix.
